findings.rule: When a loop-carried value is always sha3(k, slot) for a loop-carried key k, carry the key (k = _param1, then k = stor2[stor1[k].field_0]) and print accesses as stor1[k].field; never rebase one hash on another.

findings.source: EdgeStore.edges: mapping(bytes32 => ChallengeEdge) with a 10-slot struct (createdAtBlock at slot 8, level at slot 9)
findings.issue: A mapping of multi-slot structs is typed as a mapping of fixed arrays of one-slot structs, so struct members print as array elements with field offsets ([8].field_160 for createdAtBlock, [9].field_72 for level).
findings.rule: Constant offsets added to sha3(k, slot) are struct members of the mapping value: name them field_<slot*256+bit> of a multi-slot struct rather than array elements.
